flows.title: Set the workspace's default language
steps: Click the workspace name in the top left corner.
Under Default Workspace Language, select the language you want from the drop-down menu.
Click Save. Each Agent also carries its own language option, so one agent can work in another language.

flows.title: Change a team member's role
steps: Click the workspace name in the top left corner.
Click the ... to the right of the person's name and select Change role.
Choose the new role from the dropdown menu and click Confirm. The roles are Admin, Manager, Developer and Members, and they set what a person reaches in the workspace.
